summary: Iter-22 — verified the user-uploads bundle (B-roll + voiceover + media-library) + new /api/studio/stock-candidates endpoint + user_voiceover_url render persistence + Flux content-hash cache safety. Backend 8/8 pytest PASS after fixing 2 production bugs in /app/backend/uploads_routes.py (GridFS list_uploads + stream close). Frontend 12/13 Playwright checks PASS: 'Your media' B-Roll option, 'B-Roll · Yours' chip label, Pick from your library scene button → MediaLibrary modal with dropzone + Choose Files, VoiceRecorder inside the TTS voice modal with 'Record your voice' label, and render button correctly DISABLED when uploaded scenes lack picks. Only the cta-hint text test is PARTIAL (see below — not a bug, validation-chain ordering).

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: 500 — 'GridOut object has no attribute get'. fs.find() yields GridOut objects (attribute-access) but the handler called doc.get('metadata') on them.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Query the raw db['uploads.files'] collection instead of fs.find() so docs are plain dicts.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: TypeError: object NoneType can't be used in 'await' expression. Motor's GridOut.close() returns None synchronously (not a coroutine).
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Guard the close() — only await if it returns a coroutine.

partial_or_notes.cta-hint exact text: PARTIAL — the request asks for 'Pick a media file for each Yours scene.' but the visible hint reads 'Pick a voice or record your own.' This is because the validation chain in /app/frontend/src/pages/Studio.jsx fires the voice-missing check FIRST (before the uploaded-pick check at line 963). The exact string 'Pick a media file for each 'Yours' scene.' DOES exist in code at L963 and would appear if the user picks a voice first. Not a bug — validation ordering by design. critical_code_review_comments: uploads_routes.py — list_uploads was using fs.find() which yields GridOut objects, not dicts. Always use db['<bucket>.files'] for metadata queries; reserve the GridFS bucket only for upload/download streams.
uploads_routes.py — Motor 3.x's GridOut.close() is sync; awaiting it raises TypeError. Same pattern for stream.read(). Fixed to no-op on non-coroutine close.
server.py — POST /api/studio/render correctly persists user_voiceover_url (verified in `renders` collection). The Pydantic model RenderRequest exposes it as Optional[str] with proper default.

stock-candidates endpoint — sound design: parallel httpx fetches with per-prompt 3-cap and order preservation via idx. Source allowlist enforced (pexels|pixabay|mix). 422 on bad shapes and 400 on bad source.

Frontend — testids on every interactive element on the new flow are present and stable. ModePicker uses [data-testid='mode-picker-faceless'] (not 'mode-faceless'); the docs in the review_request implied users go straight to mode-faceless but the landing actually shows ModePicker first — minor doc/test note.

rca of the issue: Two GridFS-handling bugs in uploads_routes.py shipped without integration test coverage: (1) fs.find() yields GridOut objects (attribute-access on dynamic motor adapter), not the dict form needed by .get(). The fix queries db['uploads.files'] directly. (2) Motor's AsyncIOMotorGridOut.close() in v3.x returns None synchronously, but the streaming response used `await stream.close()`. Both bugs were latent until exercised by the listing + GET path. Reproduction: any logged-in studio user calling GET /api/studio/uploads after uploading a file would 500. Mitigation: shipped fix + new pytest module covering all 5 upload routes + listing + delete cycle to prevent regression.
